description:
Responsibilities: 
 Create processes that conduct service calls through APIs that interface with 3rd party applications 
 Design, develop and Test ETL processes per business requirements 
 Interact with business users 
 Load/extract data from multiple cloud applications (primarily Salesforce.com) and legacy applications (e.g., Oracle) 
 Define and document complex technical design/requirements for integrations and data warehousing 
 Participate in code reviews 
 Ensure designed systems are reliable, self-recovering and require minimal support 
 Ensure timing and performance objectives and goals are met 
 Develop and adhere to established programming, change management processes and standards; including naming conventions, formations and program structure 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in the development, testing and implementation lifecycles 
 Manage Informatica Cloud based tools such as Address Doctor 
 Ensure best practices are adhered to and leveraged while using Informatica Cloud 
 

 Requirements: 
 Experience using cloud instead of power center or data warehouse 
 Background in developing workflows, triggers and Visualforce pages using Salesforce.com along with integration and conversion experience using Informatica Cloud 
 familiarity with the SDLC, release management and testing 
 Minimum 5+ years in Java development 
 Minimum 2+ years of Informatica Cloud experience 
 Expert knowledge of business process flows and mappings 
 Strong knowledge and experience integrating with the Salesforce.com platform 
 Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) as well as someone who will interact with the team and who is looking to become a part of a culture 
 Preferred: 
 Informatica Cloud Certification 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 Look for: Danielle Louise 
 Phone: 346 231 7544 
 Email: d.garan@computerfutures. com
